gloss: to turn around; to look back

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {振|ふ}り{向|む}きませんでした

definitions.gloss: to turn around; to turn one's head
definitions.explanation: To physically turn to face another direction, especially behind oneself.

definitions.gloss: to pay attention to; to take notice of
definitions.explanation: To show interest in someone or something, often used in the negative.

notes:
{振|ふ}り{向|む}く is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) formed from ⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧ (to swing) + ⟦{向|む}く→向く：02304_muku⟧ (to face). It primarily describes the physical action of turning around.

ASPECT (ている):
⟦{振|ふ}り→振り：03714_furi⟧⟦{向|む}いて→向く：02304_muku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates someone has turned around and is facing that direction.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [direction]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{向|む}く — to turn toward [direction]
- [person]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{振|ふ}り{向|む}く — [person] turns around
- ⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{向|む}く (turn to look behind)
- ⟦{振|ふ}り→振り：03714_furi⟧⟦{向|む}き→向き：12041_muki⟧もしない (doesn't even turn around; ignores completely)
- ⟦{振|ふ}り→振り：03714_furi⟧⟦{向|む}いて→向く：02304_muku⟧⟦くれない→くれる：00724_kureru⟧ (won't pay attention to me)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
⟦{振|ふ}り→振り：03714_furi⟧⟦{向|む}いて→向く：02304_muku⟧⟦くれない→くれる：00724_kureru⟧ in romantic contexts means someone won't show interest or return one's feelings.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧: to look back (physical + figurative reflection)
- {振|ふ}り{向|む}く: only physical turning
